name: critic P14/P19 a2r2 (fresh eyes) — a six-year-old who only mashes Enter, and the two walls my own playthrough sims found

steps.eval: (window.tap = (code='Enter') => { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{code,key:code,bubbles:true})); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{code,key:code,bubbles:true})); }, window.mash = async (cond,max=600,d=180) => { for (let i=0;i<max;i++){ try{ if(cond()) return i; }catch(e){} window.tap(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,d)); } return -1; }, 'ok')

steps.note: A. THE FIRST FIGHT. Long Lane, Lv 1, Papa and Bobble. The child touches one key.

steps.eval: (() => { __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.fight('long_lane', {level: 1, seed: 31337}); const s = __DQ.state().snapshot; return JSON.stringify({enemies: s.enemies.map(e => e.name + ' ' + e.hp + 'hp'), party: s.party.map(p => p.name + ' Lv' + p.lvl + ' ' + p.hp + '/' + p.maxHp + ' atk' + p.atk + ' ' + (p.tactic || 'LEADER'))}); })()
mash(() => __DQ.state().snapshot.round >= 1 && !__DQ.idle(), 20, 220)
mash(() => ['victory','defeat','fled'].includes(__DQ.state().battle.phase), 30, 220)
JSON.stringify({rounds: __DQ.state().snapshot.result.rounds, exp: __DQ.state().snapshot.result.exp, gold: __DQ.state().snapshot.result.gold})
__DQ.log(22).join(' | ')

steps.note: B. THE MASHING CHILD. Enter every 140ms, nothing else, fight after fight. Presses per fight, and whether it ever stops answering.

steps.eval: (async () => { const out = []; let last = __DQ.state().carried.fights, t = 0, mark = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 620; i++) { t++; const s = __DQ.state(); const f = s.carried.fights; if (f > last) { out.push('fight' + f + ': ' + (t - mark) + ' presses (Lv' + s.carried.levels.hero + ')'); mark = t; last = f; if (f >= 6) break; } if (t - mark > 120) { out.push('*** STOPPED ANSWERING during fight ' + (f + 1) + ' after ' + (t - mark) + ' presses (' + Math.round(0.14 * (t - mark)) + 's of mashing): phase=' + s.battle.phase + ' menu=' + (s.ui.menu ? s.ui.menu.kind : 'none') + ' panel=' + JSON.stringify(s.ui.panel) + ' typing=' + s.ui.typing + ' waiting=' + s.ui.waiting + ' lines=' + JSON.stringify(s.ui.lines)); break; } if (s.carried.recruitOffer) __DQ.answer(false); tap(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,140)); } return out.join(' | '); })()
JSON.stringify({ui: __DQ.state().ui, phase: __DQ.state().battle.phase, idle: __DQ.idle(), carried: __DQ.state().carried.fights}).slice(0,1200)

(async () => { for (const k of ['Enter','Space','Escape','KeyX','KeyZ','ArrowDown']) { for (let i=0;i<10;i++) { tap(k); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,110)); } } const s = __DQ.state(); return 'after 60 more presses on six different keys: phase=' + s.battle.phase + ' menu=' + (s.ui.menu ? s.ui.menu.kind : 'none') + ' typing=' + s.ui.typing + ' idle=' + __DQ.idle(); })()

steps.note: C. The rhythm when carrying does work: fourteen fights on the Lane from Lv 1, driven the way the builder's own scenario drives it.

steps.eval: (() => { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.fight('long_lane', {level: 1, seed: 4242}); const out = []; for (let k = 0; k < 14; k++) { __DQ.autoplay(99, 'mash'); const r = __DQ.state().snapshot.result || {}; const c = __DQ.state().carried; out.push('r' + r.rounds + ' exp' + r.exp + ' Lv' + c.levels.hero); if (c.recruitOffer) __DQ.answer(false); __DQ.fight('long_lane', {carry: true}); } __DQ.instant(false); return out.join(' | '); })()

steps.note: F. THE RUNNER'S WALL my sims found: Bogwallop's door at Lv 8 (where a child who flees every wild fight arrives) vs the design Lv 15 — with the rubber band wound right up.

steps.eval: (() => { let wins = 0, rounds = []; __DQ.instant(true); for (let s = 1; s <= 20; s++) { __DQ.assist(60); __DQ.fight('sogglemarsh', {boss: true, level: 8, seed: s}); __DQ.autoplay(99, 'auto'); const r = __DQ.state().snapshot.result; if (r && r.outcome === 'victory') wins++; rounds.push(r ? r.rounds : '?'); } __DQ.instant(false); return 'Bogwallop at Lv 8, 20 tries, assist 60: wins=' + wins + ' of 20; rounds=' + rounds.join(','); })()
JSON.stringify({phase: __DQ.state().battle.phase, advice: (__DQ.state().snapshot.result || {}).advice})

(() => { let wins = 0; __DQ.instant(true); for (let s = 1; s <= 20; s++) { __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.fight('sogglemarsh', {boss: true, level: 15, seed: s}); __DQ.autoplay(99, 'mash'); const r = __DQ.state().snapshot.result; if (r && r.outcome === 'victory') wins++; } __DQ.instant(false); return 'the same door at the design Lv 15, only ever pressing Attack: wins=' + wins + ' of 20'; })()

steps.note: G. THE GRIND WALL: what a fight in the first area pays a child who has out-levelled it (the invisible EXP keel).

steps.eval: (() => { const out = []; __DQ.instant(true); for (const lv of [2, 4, 6, 8, 12]) { let exp = 0, n = 10; for (let s = 1; s <= n; s++) { __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.fight('long_lane', {level: lv, seed: 900 + s}); __DQ.autoplay(99, 'mash'); const r = __DQ.state().snapshot.result; exp += (r && r.exp) || 0; } out.push('Lv' + lv + ': ' + (exp / n).toFixed(1) + ' exp/fight'); } __DQ.instant(false); return 'Long Lane (areaLevel 2) pays — ' + out.join(' | '); })()
